article_summaries.title: Stock Up on TCG Sets 1 Through 3 Boosters This Weekend!
article_summaries.summary: A SOE news post announcing a weekend sale on Free Realms Trading Card Game (TCG) booster packs for Sets 1 through 3, at a special price of 199 SC, which is 50 SC off individual boosters. The sale ran from Friday August 31 to Tuesday September 4 (2012 dates inferred from the weekday/date pairing, not stated as a year). The post's exact publication date is not given; the page only says 'Posted 1 week, 2 hours ago'.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ?
